title: Hapgood's earth crustal displacement

tellings.quote: to Hapkut. It's that the North Pole was where Hudson Bay is today

plain: The North Pole once sat where Hudson Bay is today, according to Charles Hapgood, a writer who argued that the Earth's outer crust can slide as a whole and move the poles. Jason Jorjani, a researcher, tells Michels this as Hapgood's idea. If true, the map of the ancient world would have looked very different.
